Six billion people on Earth when the infection hit. The Krippin Virus had a 90 percent kill rate; that's 5.4 BILLION people, dead. Crashed and bled out. Dead. Less than one-percent immunity. That left 12 million healthy people, like you.

The other 588 MILLION turned into Dark Seekers, and then they got hungry, and they killed and fed on everybody. EVERYBODY!

Every single person that you or I has ever known is dead! DEAD!

THERE IS NO GOD!

[32cd32]ABOUT THE 'I AM LEGEND' MOD.[-]

Zombies (Dark Seekers) [cd5c5c]do not[-] spawn in the wild during the day. You are free to move about the world, but be warned...

[cd5c5c]Buildings are DANGEROUS[-]. They are filled with fast-moving enemies, and you'll need to be careful when looking for supplies.

There are [cd5c5c]no traders[-]; all trader compounds have been abandoned.

When night falls, you'll want to be [ffc40c]inside[-] and [ffc40c]well hidden[-]. Dark Seekers will be out in force, and they're hungry ...

In 2009 a deadly virus burned through our civilization, pushing humankind to the edge of extinction.

Dr. Robert Neville dedicated his life to the discovery of a cure, and the restoration of humanity.

On September 9th, 2012, at approximately 8:49 p.m. he discovered that cure; and at 8:52 he gave his life to defend it.

We are his legacy.

This is his legend.

After successfully completing every challenge within the Basics of Survival category, it's time to claim your well-earned rewards.

Select each completed challenge marked [00FF00]GREEN[-] and click the Redeem button below or use the shortcut [action:gui:GUI Inspect].

Redeeming all of the challenges in each group will award you with a group completion reward.

[DECEA3]Darkseekers[-] are the primary threat to your survival.

[DECEA3]Normal[-] Darkseekers make up the bulk of the threat.

[FF6666]Feral[-] Darkseekers hit harder and are tougher than normal Darkseekers.

[00FF00]Radiated, Charged, and Infernal[-] Darkseekers regenerate their health and deal severe damage, making them a stubborn threat until eliminated.

[DECEA3]Darkseekers[-] are a constant threat to your day-to-day survival.

Not only a direct danger, they can destroy [DECEA3]Blocks[-] and consume killed [DECEA3]Animals[-].

As your [DECEA3]Gamestage[-] increases, stronger, faster, and more challenging [DECEA3]Darkseekers[-] will appear.

No place is safe, as [DECEA3]Darkseekers[-] inhabit all biomes, with [DECEA3]Downtown[-] and [DECEA3]Commercial[-] areas hosting the highest concentrations, while other areas may be less populated. 

Kill a lot of [DECEA3]Darkseekers[-].
[DECEA3]Male Darkseekers[-] are intelligent, strong, and quick, with heightened senses.\n\nKill some [DECEA3]Male Darkseekers[-].
[DECEA3]Female Darkseekers[-], like their male counterparts, are strong, quick, and smart.\n\nKill some [DECEA3]Female Darkseekers[-].
These [DECEA3]Female Darkseekers[-] are a little tougher than other females, but just as quick and intelligent.\n\nKill some [DECEA3]Female Darkseekers[-].
[DECEA3]Alpha Darkseekers[-] possess superhuman strength, speed, agility and senses.\n\nKill some [DECEA3]Alpha Darkseekers[-].

[DECEA3]Radiated Alpha Darkseekers[-] are much tougher than their non-radiated variants, and will regenerate health over time. Easily spotted by their glowing green skin.\n\nKill some [DECEA3]Radiated Alpha Darkseekers[-].

[DECEA3]Spitting Darkseekers[-] hit hard in melee combat and can also attack from range with a stream of [DECEA3]Vomit[-].

After taking major damage, they will charge toward their enemy and [DECEA3]Explode[-], dealing heavy damage to nearby [DECEA3]Blocks[-] and any [DECEA3]Players[-] or [DECEA3]Zombies[-] caught in the blast.

Kill some [DECEA3]Spitting Darkseekers[-].

[DECEA3]Elite Darkseekers[-] are the toughest of the Alphas. Characterized by their glowing blue or orange skin, they are tougher, move faster, hit harder, and regenerate health over time\n\nKill some [DECEA3]Elite Darkseekers[-].
